implemented.decision_records: Existing v3 decision JSONL now includes startup artifact/configuration provenance. Updated reader accepts old v2/v3 rows without it and new rows with it; older strict readers need the accompanying update.
implemented.terminal_records: The decision-log path plus .matches.jsonl records explicit W/L/T outcomes, remaining visible protocol lines, own team, server and provenance. Both files use mode 0600. No terminal row is created for an unfinished game.
implemented.provenance: SHA-256 of startup client/helper/WASM/glue/pool/profile/optional-prior bytes, with Node version and requested driver/search configuration. Random mode records null WASM. These are local diagnostic identities, not authenticated attestations or proof that a malformed requested prior was applied.

required_inputs: Expert-player qualification or named benchmark opponents
Venue/server for the requested human comparison
